release.excerpt: This release introduces a new amendment to the XRP Ledger protocol, **`fixRemoveNFTokenAutoTrustLine`** to mitigate a potential denial-of-service attack against NFT issuers that minted NFTs and allowed secondary trading of those NFTs to create trust lines for any asset.

prs.title: Introduce fixRemoveNFTokenAutoTrustLine amendment
prs.author: scottschurr

comments.body:
Shouldn't this be rolled into an NFT v1.2 amendment instead, since NFT v1.1 is broken without this one? :-P

Nah, not going to open that can of worms again, just something to keep in mind for future decisions and discussions.

prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

It turns out that the feature enabled by the `tfTrustLine` flag on an `NFTokenMint` transaction could be used as a means to attack the NFToken issuer.  Details are in https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/issues/4300

The `fixRemoveNFTokenAutoTrustLine` amendment in this pull request removes the ability to set the `tfTrustLine` flag on an `NFTokenMint` transaction.

Closes https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/issues/4300

### Context of Change

There are two commits in this pull request.  They are both needed, but they should be kept separate (not squashed).

- The first commit, by @HowardHinnant, is required to allow the code to be compiled without warnings by the latest version of Xcode (Version 13.4.1.  This commit has already been accepted into the 1.10.0-b1 develop branch.  This first commit does not require review.

- The second commit disables the `tfTrustLine` flag on an NFTokenMint transaction.  This commit needs review.

### Type of Change

- [x] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Amendment (amendment going live will cause amendment blocking of out-of-date servers)
- [x] Tests (tests were added for the new amendment)
- [x] Requires documentation updates
